title: Baatu xam-xam ci lëndëm gi
intro: Ab nit ku amoon ca jamono yu yàgg ya, ñu xamee ko ci xam-xam bu xóot, mingi wax ak yeen ci ay xarnu yu bari. Nit kii musul wax ni mooy yonent, waaye xam-xam bu Yàlla àndaloon ci seeni kàddu. Waajur bu bàyyi fa ndono budul jeex, seen xelal ñu ngi des ci xol yu bari, ñuy jàng ak xalaat ci ba tay.
clues: Jox naa may bu Yàlla jox ma wuutale ak ñeneen ñi - xam-xam bu xóot lool ba nekk sama jikko buma ràññee ci taarix.
Duma woon ab ndaw wala malaaka - nekkoon naa nit ku am xam-xam bu xóot ak gis-gis bu xóot ci àdduna.
Lima gënoon jege mooy sama doom, te jaaraleko ci lima gëna jege sama kàddu yi gëna yàgg.
Maa ngi ñaax nit ñi ñu gërëm Ki ma jox lépp, ba noppi ma artu leen ci réy-réy ak réy-réy.
Jàngale naa ni jëf yu am solo yu tollu ci benn jiwwu mutard, ak njariñu wàññi baat ci woyof.
Amna benn chapitre ci Al Quran bu yor sama tur, foofu lañuy denc samay xelal sama doom ji ma bëgg ba fàww.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
